entries.18ad6c05d6ac87d2: Construction of factories and warehouses, among others
entries.2a77dbd20507e300: This is a category not included in reportable segments, in which the company leases real estate it owns to corporate customers. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended April 2026 was ¥13 million.
entries.4fecd7abde663798: This is construction of factories, logistics warehouses, commercial facilities, and dedicated storage warehouses for agricultural produce for agricultural cooperatives, fruit and vegetable producers, food manufacturers, and others. The company also has renovation work, such as renewal and seismic reinforcement of existing buildings, in view.
entries.5268e4cedbd3de7d: These include embankment and revetment works and weir works for flood control, dam works aimed at flood control, water utilization and conservation of the river environment, and disaster recovery works.

entries.6d37194910fd58cf: These are social infrastructure works, such as water supply and sewerage works and land development works.
entries.71a735c681acf0ca: These include shield works for utility tunnels and storm water trunk sewers, and tunnel works for the Hokkaido Shinkansen.
entries.855238fd70d10260: This is construction work on condominiums ordered by private companies. It receives orders mainly in the Greater Tokyo, Kansai and Chubu areas.
entries.8dec200e5f1212d8: These include bridge substructure works, noise barrier works, seismic reinforcement works, and road improvement works for the construction of new expressways and the widening to four lanes.

entries.a9f5556ec1ba74d3: Central government agencies, such as the Regional Development Bureaus of the Ministry of Land, Infrastructure, Transport and Tourism
entries.bc4497673575c261: Construction of schools, welfare facilities, government offices, etc.
entries.d65d44f2da2e7fe7: This business mainly undertakes condominium construction work ordered by private companies, and also takes on work ordered by government and public agencies, such as schools, welfare facilities, government offices, offices and expressway service areas, as well as construction of storage warehouses dedicated to agricultural products for agricultural cooperatives, fresh produce producers, food manufacturers and others. The consolidated subsidiary ＴＯＭＴＥＮ Co., Ltd. also conducts construction work business. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended April 2026 was ¥24,533 million.
entries.d8d84a2632eaa4d8: This is building construction work centered on public works ordered by government agencies, including welfare facilities such as schools and special nursing homes for the elderly, government office buildings, medical facilities, and service area facilities on expressways.
entries.f34443fb6cda9721: This business carries out social infrastructure construction works centered on public works ordered by central government agencies, including the Regional Development Bureaus of the Ministry of Land, Infrastructure, Transport and Tourism, local governments, and expressway companies. It undertakes road, river, water supply and sewerage, and land development works nationwide, centered on the Greater Tokyo Area and the Kansai region. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended April 2026 was ¥10,816 million.
